parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value of this parameter is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests.

parameters.name: ConditionsConfig
parameters.description: The condition configuration of the conditional access policy.

parameters.name: DecisionConfig
parameters.description: The action configuration of the conditional access policy.

parameters.name: DecisionType
parameters.description: The execution type of the conditional access policy.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: The priority of the conditional access policy.
